svg.title: workstation-steward: a new project, decided and onboarded
svg.desc: An illustrative session, looping, in three scenes. steward projects scan finds a new Node and TypeScript repo, ~/Development/web; steward projects decide records it as onboarded with AQE and Brain after a yes. steward projects onboard shows the plan per file (nine files to create, each with the keys it adds), the .git/info/exclude lines that keep git status clean, the Node the hooks will run, and the one manual step. With --apply it asks, writes a receipt with its rollback command, and git status stays clean.

text.tspan: new (1) — needs a decision (then steward projects onboard <path>):
recorded 1; registry has 13 project(s). Commit projects/registry.toml through a PR.
.git/info/exclude (files onboarding creates, so `git status` stays clean)
mise resolves Node 26.12.1 here; aqe needs >=22.13.0
aqe: Open Claude Code in the project and approve the agentic-qe server and the AQE hooks when asked.
0 edit, 9 create, 0 PR (not applied: rollout), 0 manual
plan only; `steward projects onboard <path> --apply` applies it (asks first)
check: the plan now has nothing left to apply
# nothing: the new files are listed in .git/info/exclude
